economic_ownership_map.label: Producing Green River trona / soda ash royalties (92%)
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Producing Green River trona / soda ash royalties (92%)
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Sweetwater adj. EBITDA US$66.2m / US$80.8m (circular); PR avg ~US$74m last 2 FY on 100% basis. Attributable 92%. Multiples: low 15x trough US$46m; base 18x midcycle US$68.1m; high 18x expansion US$108.9m.
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: Natural trona cost advantage vs synthetic soda ash; soft price ceiling from synthetic supply; checkerboard KSLA means ~half basin production historically.
economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Paradigm fairness EV/CY EBITDA 17-23x and EV/CY+1 13-19x (circular). Lemon Cakes fair band 15-20x. Deal prints ~26-32x on those anchors at deemed US$3.64.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: Utilization, incremental after-tax return on capital, or contract economics fall below the low-case assumptions.

economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Residual fee surface + mineral acres outside producing trona run-rate
economic_ownership_map.evidence: ~850k fee surface acres; ~4.5m mineral acres; ~300k acres under renewable leases (deal PR). No oil & gas rights emphasized. Data-center / ranching / renewables are aspirational.
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: [Assumption] Wide range until acre-level comps and water-right facts are mapped. Keep out of trough base cash.
economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: TPL rhyme is structural (rail-grant checkerboard) not commodity. Synthetic soda ash caps mineral inelasticity vs TPL oil.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: The next decision milestone fails, remaining capital rises materially, or the stated success probability no longer fits observable progress.

economic_ownership_map.label: Legacy URC uranium royalties, streams, and residual physical U
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Legacy URC uranium royalties, streams, and residual physical U
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Pre-deal URC was uranium royalty + physical accumulator; ~75% of stockpile sold to fund cash leg (Lemon Cakes / deal funding). Cameco Athabasca royalties + restart exposure remain. Pre-deal equity market ~US$375m at US$2.96 × ~127m shares — not all option value survives dilution into New URC.
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: Treat as call options on uranium price and project sanctions, not as current owner cash.
economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Old URC shareholders own ~41% of New URC; uranium expertise is the inorganic growth engine funded by trona cash.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: The next decision milestone fails, remaining capital rises materially, or the stated success probability no longer fits observable progress.

economic_ownership_map.label: Pro forma net debt + Sweetwater 8% NCI claim
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Pro forma net debt + Sweetwater 8% NCI claim
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Net debt ~US$613m (cash US$12m, debt US$625m). NCI C$134.75m (~US$98m) for ~8% Sweetwater. Thin cash after US$330m seller cash + costs.
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: Debt is non-negotiable in equity stub math.
economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Interest coverage ~0.8-1.1x on pro forma operating income — leverage is the equity story.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: The obligation, financing claim, tax, or realization friction is materially larger than the low-case reserve.
